The '''1998–99 [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]]''' was the 63rd season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece. The season began on 22 August 1998 and ended on 30 May 1999. [[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]] won their third consecutive and 28th Greek title.
